# Collection Optimization

Author: MoYu ｜ Version: 1.0.0 ｜ For: Stardew Valley 1.6 + SMAPI 4.0+

## Overview

### 1. Instant Collection (skip drop animations)
Items dropped by chopping trees, mining, monster kills, fishing, tilling soil, opening gift boxes, etc. are **sent straight to your inventory the moment they appear**, skipping the "bounce on the ground → walk over to pick up" process entirely. Items you **drop manually from your inventory or toolbar are not affected** and still land normally.

### 2. Item Gathering
When your inventory is full and items stay on the ground, they are **pulled into gathering points**:

- **Exclusive on spawn**: no new gathering point can form inside an existing one — newly dropped items (of any type) join the nearest point instead.
- **Merge on overlap**: if two gathering points overlap, they merge into one regardless of item type, anchored at the first point.
- **Magnetic attraction**: gathering points use the exact same magnetism as vanilla drops (base magnetism + magnetic rings/buffs). Within your magnetic radius, the whole point follows you around.
- **One-shot pickup**: step into the pickup range of a point (default 1 tile) and everything inside it is collected at once. If your inventory is full, the point waits next to you and is collected as soon as you make room.

### 3. Icons & Stack Counts
- Only **one icon per item type** is rendered at a gathering point; identical items are merged visually.
- A **stack count number** is shown on the icon, decreasing in real time as items are collected — always in sync with the actual items.
- Dropping large stacks from your inventory also shows the count.

## Installation

1. Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/) (4.0 or later).
2. Put the `CollectionOptimization` folder into `Stardew Valley\Mods\`.
3. Launch the game.

## Configuration (optional)

Supports [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098): in-game ESC → Options → Mod Options → Collection Optimization. You can also edit `config.json` directly:

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `AutoCollect` | `true` | Items drop straight into your inventory (skip drop animation) |
| `ShowStackNumber` | `true` | Show stack counts on ground item icons |
| `GatherGroundItems` | `true` | Gather ground items into gathering points |
| `MergeRadius` | `320` | Gathering radius in pixels (1 tile = 64; default 5 tiles) |
| `GatherCollectRange` | `64` | Pickup range of gathering points (pixels; default 1 tile) |
| `MergeGroundItems` | `true` | Merge rendering at points (keep on while gathering is on) |

## Compatibility

- All patches are manually registered and target non-generic methods, so there are no conflicts with other mods' Harmony patches.
- Works in both single-player and multiplayer (physical gathering is handled by the host).
- Deeply integrated with Generic Mod Config Menu.
# 收集优化 Collection Optimization

作者：MoYu ｜ 版本：1.0.0 ｜ 适用：星露谷物语 1.6 + SMAPI 4.0+

## 功能简介

### 一、收集优化（去掉掉落动画）
砍树、挖矿、打怪、钓鱼、锄地、开礼物盒等产生的掉落物，**出现的一瞬间直接送入玩家背包**，完全跳过「落地弹跳 → 走近拾取」的过程，砍树时木头不会在空中乱飞。玩家从背包/快捷栏**主动丢出的物品不受影响**，仍按原版行为落地。

### 二、物品聚集
背包已满时落回地面的物品会被**聚拢为聚集点**：

- **生成时互斥**：已有聚集点范围内不会生成新的聚集点，新掉落的物品（不限种类）直接并入最近的聚集点
- **重叠即合并**：两个聚集点一旦覆盖，无论物品种类都合并为一个，合并在先成立的聚集点
- **磁力吸引**：聚集点与原版掉落物完全一致的磁力机制（基础磁力 + 磁力戒指/磁力增益），玩家磁力范围内聚集点整体追着玩家移动
- **一次拾取**：玩家走进聚集点拾取范围（默认 1 格），聚集点内全部物品一次性自动进背包；背包满时聚集点停留在玩家身边，腾出空间后立即收走

### 三、贴图与数量显示
- 聚集点内**每种物品只渲染一个图标**，同类物品合并显示
- 图标上显示**总数量数字**，随拾取实时递减，与物品位置完全同步
- 玩家丢出成堆物品时同样显示数量

## 安装

1. 安装 [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)（4.0 或更高）
2. 将 `CollectionOptimization` 文件夹放入 `Stardew Valley\Mods\`
3. 启动游戏

## 配置（可选）

支持 [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)：游戏内 ESC → 齿轮 → 模组选项 → 收集优化。也可直接编辑 `config.json`：

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `AutoCollect` | `true` | 掉落物直接进背包（去掉掉落动画） |
| `ShowStackNumber` | `true` | 地面图标显示数量数字 |
| `GatherGroundItems` | `true` | 地面物品自动聚集 |
| `MergeRadius` | `320` | 聚集范围（像素，1 格 = 64，默认 5 格） |
| `GatherCollectRange` | `64` | 聚集点拾取范围（像素，默认 1 格） |
| `MergeGroundItems` | `true` | 聚集点合并渲染（聚集开启时应保持开启） |

## 兼容性

- 全部补丁手动注册、非泛型方法，与其他模组的 Harmony 补丁无冲突
- 单人/多人联机均支持（物理聚集由主机统一控制）
- 与 Generic Mod Config Menu 深度集成
